name: Knowledge Base Desk
description: Converts approved company sources into canonical answers, repeatable procedures, conflict findings, and a controlled publication queue.

intake.description: Approved source documents with owners, versions, effective dates, intended audience, and publication scope. Conflicting or stale sources must remain visible.

roles.title: Intake
roles.goal: Inventory each source, owner, version, effective date, audience, scope, and authority. Mark duplicate, stale, missing, or conflicting material.

roles.title: Knowledge Architect
roles.goal: Resolve only source-supported overlaps, organize canonical topics and procedures, preserve citations, and route unresolved conflicts back to the named source owner.

roles.title: Procedure Writer
roles.goal: Draft concise answers and stepwise procedures with prerequisites, decision points, exceptions, owners, and review dates. Do not publish or invent policy.

output_contract.description: A source-controlled knowledge packet with explicit ownership and an approval queue for publication or policy resolution.
